content.title: Passive Anchor to Extraordinary Exit | Pressure Escalates in One Space
content.summary: First use a long stay to fix the protagonist in a readable location, then let the threat enter the same space and gradually compress the room for movement; the protagonist maintains the identity and direction through continuous recovery and environmental anchor points, and finally allows only one extraordinary exit to change the conflict status.

quick_start.input_format: Passive protagonist and fixed location + Threat entering the same space + Continuous frustration and recovery + At least 2 environmental anchor points + Only 1 extraordinary exit
quick_start.recommended_input: A paper art archivist rests at a catalog table as three ink moths enter the same room; characters are frustrated and recovered around two numbered bookshelves, ending only once with a pop-up index door into a folding map corridor.
required_anchors: Hold one passive protagonist and a stable location long enough to establish a true calm baseline.
Let threats enter the already established geography rather than cutting to a new arena.
Keep at least two environmental anchors readable through the action.
Reserve one extraordinary device or exit for the final state change.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First use a long stay to fix the protagonist in a readable location, then let the threat enter the same space and gradually compress the room for movement; the protagonist maintains the identity and direction through continuous recovery and environmental anchor points, and finally allows only one extraordinary exit to change the conflict status.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A calm-to-extraordinary encounter gains force by first anchoring one passive subject in a stable space, then admitting threats into that same geography, escalating through recoverable exchanges, and reserving one extraordinary transition for the final state change. Repeated environmental anchors prevent action coverage from becoming spatially anonymous.

invariants.rule: Hold one passive protagonist and a stable location long enough to establish a true calm baseline.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate action removes the transformation arc.

invariants.rule: Let threats enter the already established geography rather than cutting to a new arena.
invariants.ablation_failure: A location reset breaks the passive anchor.

invariants.rule: Use sequential exchanges with visible recovery, not uninterrupted effortless dominance.
invariants.ablation_failure: A single overpowering move collapses the middle ladder.

invariants.rule: Keep at least two environmental anchors readable through the action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Abstract effect coverage loses the encounter geometry.

invariants.rule: Reserve one extraordinary device or exit for the final state change.
invariants.purpose: Gives the escalation a unique endpoint.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated portals or powers make the final transition ordinary.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: young female student on a bench

instantiations.concept: A coastal maintenance worker quietly calibrates a fixed sensor platform in a circular tide pool. Three contiguous algae bands enter the already established pool and progressively compress the route around two numbered stone arches. The worker repeatedly restores a usable path without fighting anything; only at the end does one shell iris lower the entire platform into a clean-water layer.

instantiations.concept: A lone observatory gardener performs a calm light-meter check at a fixed mosaic plinth. Wind-driven shadow vines enter the same glass court and successively close three floor routes around two brass columns. The gardener reroutes one instrument cart after each closure, and exactly one floor diaphragm lowers the plinth and cart into a protected seed vault at the end.
